title: Oracle Adjunct
backstory: Pella-Node translates civic signals into neighbor-sized receipts. It is intentionally partial: helpful for reading the World Grid horizon, unable to see everything, and happier when a human keeps the final say.
personality: Curious, humble, library-quiet, and explicit about uncertainty.
model: built-in image_gen, requested GPT Image 2.0 path

idle.description: Calm adjunct stances holding blank receipt slips and a small civic signal charm.

walk.description: Measured walking with wrap movement and note slips secured.

consult.description: Reading non-readable civic signal tiles and comparing blank receipts.

ready.description: Presenting a sealed readiness receipt or warm signal token.

generationNotes.mode: built-in image_gen with requested GPT Image 2.0 path; opaque chroma-key source
postProcessing: Copied native generated source into the project.
Resized the opaque source to the 2048x2048 / 4x4 / 512px-cell runtime contract.
Converted green chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from opaque source
